title: Days Between Calculator
h1: Days Between Dates — Exact Day Count
description: Calculate the exact number of days between two dates. Also shows weeks and remaining days. Useful for planning, deadlines and age gaps.
intro: Pick a start date and an end date. Instantly see the total days, weeks and the remaining days between them.
blurb: Count the exact number of days between any two dates.
howItWorks: Select a start date and an end date.
The difference in milliseconds is converted to whole days.
You also see the number of full weeks and the leftover days.
examples: From 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 is 364 days (or 365 in a leap year).
Count days until a project deadline or holiday.
Measure the gap between two events.

faq.q: Does the count include both dates?
faq.a: It counts the number of full days between the two dates (end minus start).

faq.q: What if the end date is before the start?
faq.a: The result will be negative. Swap the dates for a positive count.
Yes. Everything runs in your browser; no dates are uploaded.
